subtasks.title: StagingLiveHitLeaderQuery — batched kit leaderboard on hits_cold
subtasks.approach: New ClickhouseQuery subclass modelled structurally on the FIXED HitPlateStatsBatchQuery (NOT RecoveryLeaderQuery, which hardcodes the clarity. prefix, joins clarity.kits, and uses addslashes()). Shared private fromAndWhere(string $clarityDb, int $orgId, string $start, string $end) emitting: FROM {clarityDb}.hits_cold FINAL WHERE kit_org_id = {orgId} AND hit_type = 'S' AND hit_created_at >= toDateTime('{start}') AND hit_created_at <= toDateTime('{end}') AND _peerdb_is_deleted = 0. Measure is uniqExactIf(ocr, hit_type = 'S') AS total — a bare count() is FORBIDDEN (hits_cold's mutable hit_created_at is in the sort key, so duplicates survive FINAL and counts run ~30% high). Label via anyLast(kit_name) — hits_cold carries kit_name, so NO join. handle(): GROUP BY kit_id ORDER BY total DESC, kit_id ASC LIMIT 10, returned keyed by kit_id (never by name — DEV-2430's non-unique-name hazard). handleMonthly(): adds toStartOfMonth(hit_created_at) AS month, GROUP BY month, kit_id ORDER BY month ASC, total DESC, kit_id ASC LIMIT 10 BY month, returned as ['Y-m' => [kit_id => {id,name,total}]] — ONE round trip for the whole window. Use static::clarityDb() and the strict assertDatetime() allowlist copied from HitPlateStatsBatchQuery. TDD: write the test first and confirm red->green.
subtasks.intended_diffs: NEW query class ~130 lines mirroring HitPlateStatsBatchQuery's structure (const DATETIME_PATTERN, private static fromAndWhere(), public static handle(), public static handleMonthly(), private static assertDatetime()) + NEW RequiresClickhouse test class pinning: uniqExactIf dedup vs bare count() on a duplicate-id/differing-hit_created_at fixture; ranking with kit_id ASC tiebreak; hit_type='S' isolation (an 'L'/'H'/'Z' row must not count); kit_org_id vs hotlist_org_id axis isolation; _peerdb_is_deleted=0 filtering; handleMonthly() month bucketing with LIMIT 10 BY month across >10 kits; handleMonthly() assertSame()-agreeing with handle() over an identical single-month window; malformed datetime rejected. Freeze the clock (setTestNow) near the fixture dates — hits_cold fixtures must be recent.

subtasks.title: StagingLiveHitLeader widget — RecoveryLeader-shaped card, gated, sparkline agreeing with the sibling
subtasks.approach: New widget: class StagingLiveHitLeader extends ChartWidget implements DashboardMetricCard, use BuildsDateFilterChartSeries, RendersDashboardStat, StatHelper. Deliberately NOT DashboardWidget and NOT the SharedHitStatsData trait — both model a SCALAR per month and cannot represent a ranked list; and using the trait in a 5th class would give that class its OWN copy of static::$sharedUniqueMonthlyStats (the DEV-2406 trait-static-per-class hazard) and cause a 5th ClickHouse scan. getCardKey() = 'staging-live-hit-leader'. LEADERBOARD BUCKETS: per-month cache keys in this card's OWN namespace, filled by ONE handleMonthly() call spanning only min..max of the missing months, invoked DIRECTLY (never through ClickhouseQuery::query(), which swallows Throwable and would persist a real outage as an empty leaderboard), wrapped in try/catch that in production|testing report()s and sets a short-TTL negative-cache failure marker then returns, and rethrows elsewhere — mirroring SharedHitStatsData::resolvePastUniqueMonths() exactly. SPARKLINE (Q3): must read the cross-card key 'staging-live-hits:unique:{Y-m}:org={orgId}' — the literal shape SharedHitStatsData writes ($prefix.':'.UNIQUE_NAMESPACE.$monthKey.':org='.$orgId, where UNIQUE_NAMESPACE = 'unique:') from HitPlateStatsBatchQuery::handle(). CRITICAL ORDERING HAZARD found by the driver: this card is mockup slot 10 and staging-live-hits is slot 15, so CompanyMetricsOverview::getStats() renders THIS card FIRST, and on a cold cache those keys are still empty — reading them naively would draw a flat-zero sparkline. So the card must be able to FILL them too, using the SAME HitPlateStatsBatchQuery::handle() batch call, the SAME key shape and the SAME getCacheTTL(1) past-month TTL, so whichever card renders first populates them and the other reads them. That keeps the deduped monthly series at exactly ONE ClickHouse call shared across both cards, which is the whole point of the ticket's cross-class cache-KEY rule. Anchor month keys with the same monthKeyStart() day-of-month-overflow guard the trait uses, and key by timezone as the trait does. leaderboardForSelectedRange(): this_month reads the last cached bucket; today/last_7d/last_month issue ONE single-window handle() call via ::query(cache:true). toStat(): headline = the leader's count, hardcoded ->color('warning') (Q2: no getStatColor arm), plus ->chart(the agreeing sparkline series). canViewCardData(): static, MUST be total with no authenticated user (guard the auth dereference — Dashboard::cardWidgets() reaches it unauthenticated), returning Feature::active(FeatureEnum::COMPANY_METRICS->slug()) || session()->has('admin_impersonator'). getData(): stacked bar, one dataset per kit_id, label resolved from the LATEST month that kit appears in. AC-4 TEST-DESIGN CORRECTION (supersedes the prep): the cache-seed + pgsql-bridge 'a stray query throws' technique is INVALID in this env, because the CH correctness tests require real clarity.* tables to exist, so a stray query now succeeds silently and such a test cannot fail. DB::listen is still unusable for CH. Use, in order of preference: (1) system.query_log with an explicit SYSTEM FLUSH LOGS to make it deterministic, counting queries matching the shape before/after a render — the only option that truly measures round trips; (2) a spy/partial mock counting handleMonthly()/handle() invocations, deterministic but counts PHP calls not round trips; (3) a value-based gap proof — seed only some months and assert the uncached months come back correct while seeded ones are untouched. If (1) cannot be made deterministic, use (2) and say so in the test docblock. Never leave a test that cannot fail.
subtasks.intended_diffs: NEW widget ~300 lines following RecoveryLeader's method layout + NEW widget test pinning: getCardKey(); toStat() single-headline shape and colour; the sparkline AGREEING with the sibling card's cached monthly values (the Q3 acceptance); date-filter round trip across all four options; lockedStat() computing no value and emitting no chart for a non-entitled org; the admin_impersonator bypass; canViewCardData() not erroring with no authenticated user; ClickHouse-failure containment (no fabricated empty leaderboard cached, marker set and respected, already-cached months still rendering); and AC-4's round-trip proof — warm cache issues ZERO ClickHouse calls and a cold cache issues exactly ONE batched call for the 13-month series, proven with the cache-seed technique (DB::listen CANNOT count ClickHouse queries — DashboardCardMetricsTest.php:838), precedent HotlistCountTest.php:196-224.

sizing_gate.reasoning: The flow's gate trips above 6 files or on multiple distinct concerns. Production files are exactly 6 — at the limit, not over; the other 4 are the mandatory tests for those changes, and counting mandatory tests would trip this gate on nearly every ticket.
